mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_shares (token_hash, result_id, member_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{resultId}, #{memberId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.expires_at AS share_expires_at, s.revoked_at AS revoked_at, r.slug AS slug, r.result_json AS result_json, r.input_json AS input_json, r.status AS status, r.deleted_at AS deleted_at, r.expires_at AS result_expires_at, p.status AS payment_status FROM report_shares s JOIN fortune_results r ON r.id = s.result_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash}
